provider.name: Index Fungorum
provider.organization_type: global fungal nomenclature, authorship, bibliography, registration, identifier, synonymy, taxonomic-reference, and web-service infrastructure
provider.description: Index Fungorum is a global nomenclatural database for fungi and related organisms. It provides scientific names, authorship, publication citations, nomenclatural status, type information, persistent record identifiers, author and publication indexes, registration support, web services, and links to Species Fungorum for accepted-name and taxonomic information.
institutional_context: Recognized fungal-name repositories and taxonomic databases

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Index Fungorum documentation, fungal-name records, authors, publications, nomenclatural status, accepted names, synonymy, registration, identifiers, Species Fungorum, web services, downloads, standards, licenses, citations, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Index Fungorum, Species Fungorum, Royal Botanic Gardens Kew, applicable nomenclatural codes, recognized registration repositories, and cited publications remain authoritative for fungal names, identifiers, authorship, status, taxonomy, registration, versions, and legal conditions.
